SELECT
  window_start,
  window_end,
  merchant_id,
  COUNT(*) AS settled_payment_count,
  SUM(amount) AS settled_amount
FROM TABLE(
  TUMBLE(TABLE payment_events, DESCRIPTOR(event_time), INTERVAL '5' MINUTES)
)
WHERE status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY window_start, window_end, merchant_id
HAVING SUM(amount) >= 10000.00;

SELECT
  window_start,
  window_end,
  page_id,
  COUNT(*) AS view_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) AS unique_visitors
FROM TABLE(
  HOP(TABLE page_view_stream, DESCRIPTOR(event_time), INTERVAL '2' MINUTES, INTERVAL '10' MINUTES)
)
WHERE is_internal = FALSE
GROUP BY window_start, window_end, page_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) >= 20;
